title: Choose the new visual world for AI Stats
question: The roll assigned a modular evidence patch bay. Keep it, choose the strongest alternate, steer the direction, or re-roll.

options.label: Modular Evidence Patch Bay
options.lineage: broadcast patch panels, signal-routing matrices, and modular test equipment
options.thesis: Every shortlist is a visible route from independent evidence to a practical model decision.
options.viewport: A live decision bus routes Artificial Analysis, Epoch, SimpleBench, PoliBench, price, and latency into a task-specific shortlist.
options.case: The mechanism matches the product: source provenance stays visible while users compose a decision.
options.risk: The routing metaphor fails if decorative cables outrun information hierarchy.

raised.raise: Borrow exact tab discipline so every dense evidence view has a dependable place.
Borrow instrument-grade status behavior for freshness, confidence, and ingestion health.
Borrow reversible folding logic for filters and task presets.
Borrow decisive scale shifts so the selected model and governing tradeoff read instantly.

options.label: Metrology Calibration Bench
options.lineage: precision metrology labs, calibration certificates, and serialized instruments
options.thesis: Model claims behave like measurements: dated, calibrated, attributable, and honest about uncertainty.
options.viewport: A cream instrument bench centers a task selector, a calibrated shortlist, and source receipts with visible uncertainty.
options.case: This is the clearest expression of trustworthy AI measurement and the strongest long-term design system.
options.risk: It can feel clinical unless decisions remain fast, warm, and plainly written.

options.label: Acetate Reference Manual
options.lineage: boxed-software manuals, acetate dividers, and technical field references
options.thesis: AI Stats becomes the definitive model field manual, organized for fast retrieval and careful cross-reference.
options.viewport: A wide open manual uses colored edge tabs for Choose, Compare, Benchmarks, Sources, and Freshness.
options.case: Exceptionally clear and scalable, but its document metaphor is less native to interactive model selection.
options.risk: Dense documentation can make the first useful answer feel farther away.

options.label: Night-Flight Instrument Six-Pack
options.lineage: night cockpit instruments, disciplined scan patterns, and warning annunciators
options.thesis: The market becomes a calm instrument panel where trend, risk, speed, cost, and freshness can be scanned at a glance.
options.viewport: Six primary instruments summarize the active model shortlist above a compact evidence and routing strip.
options.case: Trustworthy and focused, but a fixed gauge grammar does not scale naturally to dozens of benchmarks.
options.risk: The cockpit metaphor can become theatrical when every metric is forced into a dial.

options.label: Orizuru Fold Sequence
options.lineage: origami instruction diagrams and reversible fold notation
options.thesis: A model decision unfolds through a strict sequence of visible constraints.
options.viewport: A single folded decision path moves from task constraints to a compact shortlist.
options.case: Elegant for guided selection, but too linear for open exploration and cross-source evidence.
options.kept: Reversible, stepwise filtering with every constraint visible.
options.risk: The metaphor becomes decorative as soon as users compare several branches.

options.label: Alphabet Storm
options.lineage: experimental type specimens and information-scale typography
options.thesis: The winning tradeoff becomes monumental type while the supporting evidence forms its weather system.
options.viewport: One model and one governing tradeoff dominate the page in transformational typography.
options.case: Memorable but too volatile for a data product whose evidence must stay calm and comparable.
options.kept: Use scale aggressively to reveal the current decision and its governing tradeoff.
options.risk: Expression can overwhelm comparison accuracy and sustained use.

options.label: Saturated Seedbed Lobes
options.lineage: scientific growth diagrams and saturated ecological field maps
options.thesis: Model families grow as colored evidence regions whose overlap reveals usable capability territory.
options.viewport: A full-field capability map uses overlapping lobes to reveal model families and task fit.
options.case: Visually decisive, but spatial overlap obscures native benchmark scales and exact comparisons.
options.kept: Commit whole regions of the page to unmistakable source and state color.
options.risk: The organic map reads as interpretation before the data earns it.

options.label: HyperCard Evidence Stack
options.lineage: HyperCard stacks, shoebox research files, and linked evidence trails
options.thesis: Every model, benchmark, and source is a linked card with an exact trail back through history.
options.viewport: A layered stack opens on the active decision card with source history one click behind it.
options.case: Excellent for provenance trails, but too card-bound for broad comparison and contemporary density.
options.kept: Preserve exact history, backtracking, and durable deep links for every evidence view.
options.risk: The nostalgic interface can overpower the product’s current-market authority.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished analytics dashboard with conventional navigation, filter bars, tables, and comparison charts.
canonCard.viewport: A familiar dashboard hero introduces market totals, a model table, and benchmark leaderboards.
canonCard.risk: Competent and usable, but difficult to distinguish from every other modern data dashboard.
